info.title: API.SH: Trakt
info.description: The Trakt API from API.SH: public Trakt data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: TV and movie calendar: episodes, premieres, finales, releases
get.description:
What airs or releases from a start date for 1-33 days: all episodes, new shows, season premieres, finales, movie releases, DVD releases or streaming releases, each with full details. Every search filter can narrow it. Without `start_date` it starts today (or `days_ahead` days from today).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trakt-calendar

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Start this many days from today when no start_date is given.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Release year or range, e.g. `2024` or `2010-2019`.

parameters.name: votes
parameters.description: Trakt vote count range as `min-max`, e.g. `1000-100000`.

parameters.name: networks
parameters.description: Show networks by name, comma separated (`HBO,Netflix`); shows only.

parameters.name: network_ids
parameters.description: Trakt network ids, comma separated; shows only.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Show status, comma separated: `returning series`, `continuing`, `in production`, `planned`, `upcoming`, `pilot`, `canceled`, `ended`; shows only.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Titles, overviews and taglines in every language, plus aliases
get.description:
A movie's, show's or episode's translated title, overview and tagline per language and country, optionally for one language; movies and shows also return their aliases (alternative titles by country).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trakt-translations

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The title: Trakt slug, Trakt number, IMDb id or a trakt.tv link (a season or episode link also sets `season` and `episode`).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season number (0 is specials); for `type=season` or `episode`.

parameters.name: episode
parameters.description: Episode number in the season; for `type=episode`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

translations.overview: والتر وايت مدرس كيمياء موهوب يعيش حياة هادئة ومتواضعة مع عائلته، إلى أن يكتشف إصابته بالسرطان ويقرر تأمين مستقبل أسرته قبل فوات الأوان. يستع…
مدرس كيمياء في مدرسة ثانوية على وشك الوفاة بسبب السرطان، يشترك مع طالب سابق في صناعة وبيع عقار "الميث" لتأمين مستقبل أسرته.

get.summary: Trakt user profile
get.description:
A public Trakt profile: name, avatar, location, about, gender as shown, VIP flags, join date and stats (plays, watched, minutes, ratings, comments, social). A private profile shows only its name. Age is never returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trakt-user

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: A Trakt username or a trakt.tv/users link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
